<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **37** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**25** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `routeManager (19 routes)`, `resolveProtocol (25 routes)`
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `master_detail (literal, 33 pages)`, `/data/:object (route, 66 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **145** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2967f94728bedcc75c10067bf4b2c4039e3b3327` — the merge of head `e62024d87b7e8a2be6340cafcaf0f4dfae496e11` into base `8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2967f94728bedcc75c10067bf4b2c4039e3b3327 && git checkout 2967f94728bedcc75c10067bf4b2c4039e3b3327
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759 e62024d87b7e8a2be6340cafcaf0f4dfae496e11 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759 && git merge --no-ff e62024d87b7e8a2be6340cafcaf0f4dfae496e11

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8133cc78052c95b6efd59487b64fe78f69860759` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `e62024d87b7e8a2be6340cafcaf0f4dfae496e11`
Local-runs: none

**Face:** the declaration face. This is a move-only slice of `@objectstack/rest` plus four evidence paths in `@objectstack/spec`'s shipped liveness ledger. The diff does seven things:
- it moves one registrar body into one new module, `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`, with two receiver tokens changed under the seat's `static` exception;
- it moves three body-only import names with that body and leaves a pointer comment for each;
- it grows the registrar list 11 → 12 and re-points the nine readers of that list;
- it re-points one gate's target table, `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`;
- it adds one ADR anchor file for the new module;
- it re-points one platform-checklist source string;
- it re-points four evidence paths in `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` and adds a `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset.

`record-recognisers --template --paths` over the 17-path list finds no published schema and no governed path and defers to the changeset's `Clause-②:` line. That line reads `no` with no arm, so the face is the declaration face, `TIER_DEFAULT`. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` concluded success.

**Inputs:**
- card #23050: its body and all 49 comments. These include the triage `6126748916`, slice 1's claim, acceptance and landing (`6134225153`, `6135541164`, `6136102437`), slice 2's refinement `6189011700`, the `static` ruling `6205442867`, the provider ruling `6215084478`, the slice 11 claim `6222884615`, the three slice 11 `os-dev-report`s (`6225333915` blocked, `6225878705`, `6227643349`) and the seat ruling `6225503839`;
- slice 10's record `6220613093` on PR #23990 and slices 8–9's records `6214674841` (PR #23882) and `6217704682` (PR #23959), used as precedent;
- PR #24054:
  - its body;
  - its file list: 17 files, +715 / −469, which matches `git diff --numstat` file for file;
  - its one comment, the advisory Docs Drift Check;
  - its timeline: the labels, and the cross-references it carries, among them the declaration `6225495254` on #6017, its receipt `6225865295` and amendment `6225900470` there, #24063, and #24036's claim `6226218270`;
- the net diff against the merge base `8133cc780`;
- the 48 check-runs on this head, read last.

**Method:** read-only. Every count below was read off the git objects of the merge base and the head with `git show`, text `diff` and `grep`, plus two text-only count scripts. One applies the dogfood census's population rule (direct sites, less the forwarder slice, plus the helper's call sites) and its two realtime tripwire regexes to the text. The other sums the route-envelope gate's `MODULES` table. No repository code was built, tested or re-run.

The `rest-server.ts` blob is `b429a90b19` at the dev's base `fd0e72abc`, at the first merge's `2b274600b` and at the merge base `8133cc780`. So the PR's base line numbers apply as written. The branch has **two** merges of `origin/main`, not one:
- `22352ffd7` (of `2b274600b`) changes none of the PR's files: each is the same blob at `de5848dae` and `22352ffd7`.
- `e62024d87` (of `8133cc780`, after #24056 landed through PR #24069) changes one PR file, `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`. Git combined main's route-ledger row (88 → 92) with this slice's lines, and the net diff against `main` carries only this slice's lines (+22 / −6).
- `rest-server.ts` (`7958e3cf72`) and `form-routes.ts` (`464bbaa4d1`) are the same blobs at `de5848dae`, `22352ffd7` and the head. So the dev's late-binding and route legs, run at `de5848dae`, read the head's code.

### ① Derived judgments

No accept set changes. `@objectstack/rest`'s published surface does not change. `@objectstack/spec`'s published bytes change only in four evidence strings of `liveness/view.json`. Each change the diff makes is judged below.

1. **The moved body is byte-identical once de-indented, except the two ruled receiver tokens: right.**
   - Base `rest-server.ts` `:9084`–`:9527` is 444 lines. With one 4-space indent removed, it is diffed against head `form-routes.ts` `:110`–`:553`. `diff` reports exactly body lines 198 and 229 (base `:9281` and `:9312`, head `:307` and `:338`): `...RestServer.translateOptionsFor(i18n, locale),` became `...this.translateOptionsFor(i18n, locale),`.
   - With `this.translateOptionsFor(` mapped back to `RestServer.translateOptionsFor(`, `diff` exits 0 over all 444 lines.
   - Every non-empty line in the range starts with 4 spaces. The range has 7 empty lines and no trailing whitespace. Its only two odd-backtick lines (body `:340`–`:341`) are `//` comment lines, so removing the indent changed no runtime string.
   - `RestServer.` appears in the body on those two lines only. The member is `private static translateOptionsFor` (head `rest-server.ts` `:3983`), whose whole body is `return metaReadGate.metaTranslateOptions(i18n, locale);`. It reads nothing but its two arguments, so the receiver is the whole difference. This is the `static` exception ruled in `6205442867` and named for this slice in the claim `6222884615`.
   - The rest of `rest-server.ts` changes by +25 / −447:
     - three import names removed (`anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` with its one comment line, `PUBLIC_FORM_SERVER_MANAGED_FIELDS`, `isExpectedRouteError`), each replaced by a pointer comment;
     - the new import and its comment (head `:315`–`:316`);
     - the stub (head `:9089`–`:9105`): a 5-line comment, the 9-member host literal and `registerFormEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`.
   - The file goes from 9,915 to 9,493 lines: 9,915 − 447 + 25.
   - The private method keeps its name, JSDoc and position. Base `:9048`–`:9083` against head `:9053`–`:9088` diffs to 0.
   - `registerRoutes` is identical: base `:4757`–`:4831` against head `:4762`–`:4836`, 75 lines. The call `this.registerFormEndpoints(bp);` moved from base `:4782` to head `:4787` only because of the import lines above it. It is under no switch, after `registerEmailEndpoints` and before the capability routes, so the registration order holds on every base.

2. **The host lists exactly what the body reads: right.**
   - The body's code reads of `this.` (no comment in the body mentions `this.`): `resolveProtocol` 3, `resolveAnonymousFormTenancy` 1, `readFormObjectDefinitions` 1, `routeManager` 2, `resolveI18nService` 1, `buildTranslationBundle` 1, `extractLocale` 1, `packagedObjectBase` 2, plus the static twice.
   - `FormRouteHost` (`:91`–`:101`) declares exactly these 9. Each is typed by indexed access on the class, and the static is typed on `typeof RestServer`.
   - The body has no bare `this`, no element access on `this` and no `function` keyword. The two `'function'` hits are `typeof` string literals.
   - Base `rest-server.ts` has 58 top-level declarations. The body names only one of them, `RestServer`, in the two static accesses. Every other free name is an import, and `form-routes.ts` imports each one from the module `rest-server.ts` imports it from: the four `anonymousForm*` names from `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `GetMetaItemsRequest` and `CreateDataRequest` from `@objectstack/spec/api`, `PUBLIC_FORM_SERVER_MANAGED_FIELDS` from `@objectstack/spec/security`, `mapDataError` and `isExpectedRouteError` from `./error-response.js`, `logError` from `./log.js`.
   - The three names only this body reads each had exactly one other occurrence at base, its import line. At head `rest-server.ts` holds them only in the pointer comments (0 code reads). So moving their import names is required, and right. The other eight still have code reads in `rest-server.ts`, so their imports stay.
   - The module's imports from sibling modules are all type-only: `RestServer` from `./rest-server.js`, `TransportScopedMetaRequest` from `./ui-routes.js` (slice 10's ruling A, `6220753007`) and `ServerScopedDataRequest` from `./data-action-routes.js`. They are erased at build, so the slice adds no runtime import cycle and copies no type.

3. **Value or closure, member by member: right.**
   - **`routeManager` goes by value.**
     - Its two reads (`form-routes.ts` `:203` and `:408`) are top-level `register` statements, which run during registration.
     - The class assigns the field only in the constructor (head `:2143`) and in the try/finally swap (`:5151` / `:5155`) inside `registerMetadataEndpoints` (`:5069`). That method has returned before `registerForBase` reaches the form call.
     - The interface marks the member `readonly`.
   - **The seven methods and the static go as late-bound closures.** Their receiver is still the server, and the static is read from the class at call time.
   - **No getter is owed.** The body reads no field at request time and no provider, so the provider ruling (`6215084478`) does not apply.
   - The dev's late-binding measurement, its two closure ablations and its base leg are the dev's, not re-run here. They match this reading.

4. **Nothing `@objectstack/rest` publishes moves: right.**
   - The package publishes `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. Its `exports` map has one entry, `.`, which resolves to `dist/index`.
   - `src/index.ts` is untouched. It re-exports from `./rest-server.js` by name only (`RestServer`, `RestProtocol`, `MountedRoute`, `metaItemPackageBinding`) and names no form module.
   - `rest-server.ts` has 39 lines starting with `export ` at base and at head, line for line the same.
   - `form-routes.ts` exports `FormRouteHost` and `registerFormEndpoints`. Neither is reachable from `src/index.ts`.
   - A private member is emitted in the `.d.ts` with no type, and its docblock is unchanged (item 1).
   - The dev's `.d.ts` sha `0a3edce6…`, equal to `main`'s own build at `8133cc780` through a base leg, and the 39-export lists are the dev's evidence, not re-run here. They are what this construction predicts.

5. **The registrar list and every reader were re-counted, and no reader was loosened: right.**
   - The list grows 11 → 12 by one appended entry. Each of the nine readers moves its length pin 11 → 12.
   - **execctx census.**
     - Sites (`this.resolveExecCtx(environmentId, req)`): 62 at both. Head: 22 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 0.
     - Mentions of `resolveExecCtx`: 125 at both. `rest-server.ts` reads 60 at both, and `form-routes.ts` reads 0.
     - `MOVED_REGISTRARS_READING_NO_EXECCTX` gains `form-routes.ts: 1`. That is exact, not a loosening. The forwarder pin reads (12 − 1) + 3 − 2 = 12, the same 12 as before ((11 − 1) + 3 − 1). The host carries no `resolveExecCtx` member. A form body that started reading the seam would gain a forwarder, read 13 and red. It is the shape slice 7 used for `discovery-routes.ts`.
   - **ui-view pair:** over the list, `this.enforceAuth(` reads 59 and `this.resolveExecCtx(` 74, at base and at head. The floors of 40 are unchanged. The body spells neither term, nor the ownership guard, so that pin's readings are unchanged.
   - **dogfood blind-spot row:**
     - Recomputed with the census's own rule, the population is 70 / 19 / 51 at base and at head.
     - `this.routeManager.register(` reads 63 at both: base 20 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1, head 18 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2.
     - `private register*Endpoints(` 16, `registerPerItemRoute(` 8, `const registerPerItemRoute =` 1 and the forwarder slice 1 are each unchanged.
     - `enforceAuth` reads 108 at both. `form-routes.ts` spells it 0 times, so no call site moved and no seam mention was added.
     - The new control `form-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` reads 2, and `registrar list length` reads 12. The form doors are outside `registerMetadataEndpoints` before and after.
   - **docblock pin:**
     - The module has exactly 3 TSDoc openers (`:3`, `:82`, `:103`), none stacked, and its floor is 3.
     - `rest-server.ts` keeps 163 at both, because the body held none.
     - The floors' sum goes 44 → 47 = 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 8 + 5 + 3 + 3 + 4 + 3, and the sum is pinned exactly.
   - **query-number 9, canonical-query 4, meta-draft 8:**
     - The module has 0 `Number` / `parseInt` / `parseFloat` tokens and no unary plus.
     - It has 0 `query:` slot lines (by `querySlots`' own regex) and 0 draft switches (`'draft'`, `previewDrafts`, `listDrafts`).
     - Each new floor is 0, and each sum is unchanged. The canonical census's `form-routes.ts: 0` key is required by its `Record` type.
   - **dogfood realtime tripwires:** both probe regexes read 0 on each of the twelve files.

6. **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` is re-pointed, not loosened: right.**
   - The gate's diff is +33 / −2. The two removed lines are the `rest-server.ts` row's two numbers, 15 → 11 and 13 → 7, each with a "NOT progress — the same MOVE" history comment. The rest is one new `MODULES` entry and its comment. No rule or other entry changes.
   - Counted on the module by `scanSource`'s own rules, over its nine `.json(` calls:
     - `:211` and `:416`, each door's 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` with a string-literal `error`: `stringError` and `siblingCode`;
     - `:216` and `:421`, each door's 404 `FORM_NOT_FOUND` with a template-literal `error`: `stringError` and `siblingCode`;
     - `:394`, the 500 `FORM_RESOLVE_FAILED` with a call-expression `error`: `siblingCode` only;
     - `:477`, the 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, whose `error` is a `+` concatenation, not a literal: `siblingCode` only;
     - `:385` and `:538`: object literals with neither key; `:546`: the argument is not a literal.
     - So the counts are 4 and 6, as declared.
   - `rest-server.ts`'s `.json(` calls go 84 → 75: exactly the nine moved calls, and the stub has none. So its row drops by exactly 4 and 6.
   - Both sums hold, read off the head's table:
     - `stringError`: 11 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 + 0 + 1 + 4 = 39;
     - `siblingCode`: 7 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 3 + 0 + 1 + 6 = 54.
     - These equal the base table's 39 and 54.
   - `auditDialectOnly` requires each count to equal its pin and reds in both directions, so the pins are as tight as before. The module matches `discover()`'s `*-routes.ts` convention. The entry is `dialectOnly` with ratchet `#9559`, like the ten moved modules before it.
   - `Lint & Repo Gates` concluded success.

7. **`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`: four path substitutions, and each one resolves: right.**
   - The diff is 3 lines, each an `evidence` value. No `status`, `verifiedAt`, `evidenceScope` or `note` changes.
   - **`form.sections`** → `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts registerFormEndpoints`. The module names `sections` 16 times (the key-mention rule), and `registerFormEndpoints` is its export (`:109`). The edit also drops base's `registerPublicFormEndpoints`, a name the tree never had, as the declaration listed.
   - **`form.sharing`** → `form-routes.ts#findPublicFormView` (`:128`) and `#resolveFormBySlug` (`:170`). Both are present as words (the `isSymbolNamed` rule), and the module names `sharing` twice.
   - **`formViews`** → `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts#anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`, the amendment's citation.
     - The symbol is declared at `:84` and reads `v.formViews` at `:89`–`:90`. The file names `formViews` 5 times.
     - It is on the doors' read path. `findPublicFormView` (`form-routes.ts` `:134`) iterates `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates(view)`, imported from `@objectstack/metadata-core`, which re-exports the same binding from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (`metadata-core` `anonymous-form-intake.ts` `:52`–`:57`).
     - The first substitution could not hold: `form-routes.ts` spells `formViews` 0 times, so the key-mention check refuses it. So the amendment is what makes the row hold.
     - The row's second pointer already cites `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, so spec-side evidence is not a new form for this row.
   - **The quotes are not re-pointed:** `slugMatchesPublicLink(sharing.publicLink, slug)` and `const formViews = view.formViews` occur nowhere in the head tree outside `view.json`. That was already true at base; it is carried (③ item 4).
   - **Leaving `verifiedAt` as it was is right.** A path substitution re-verifies nothing, so a new date would overstate the claim's age.
   - `Spec property liveness` concluded success.

8. **The new ADR anchor is faithful: right.**
   - `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__form-routes.ts.json` names ADR-0131, ADR-0056 and ADR-0112. The moved body cites ADR-0131 twice (`:145`, `:259`), ADR-0112 once (`:466`) and ADR-0056 once (`:502`), the same counts it had at base. All three ADR files exist.
   - The invariant matches the code: the submit runs as `publicFormGrant: { object: match.object }`, filters by `allowedFields` and `PUBLIC_FORM_SERVER_MANAGED_FIELDS`, and refuses a zero-field form with the catalog's 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`.
   - Slices 4, 6 and 7 added anchors of the same kind. The path is not governed.

9. **The checklist source re-point is right, but it covers half of the item.**
   - Item 14 of `access-security.json`, `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers`: its `source` string now names `form-routes.ts#registerFormEndpoints`. That anchor resolves (`:109`), and `resolveFormBySlug` lives there.
   - The same item's `acceptance` verify prose (head `:1556`) still reads "`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts#registerFormEndpoints` reads the environment's view list alone and drops a candidate that … `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` finds withdrawn". The code that does that moved.
   - It still resolves by name, because the private method stays. That is the case slice 1's ruling A judged harmless for anchors that name the registrar. So this is not blocking (③ item 8).

10. **The readers left untouched read no moved line: right.**
    - **Line citations:** the tree holds 50 `rest-server.ts:NNNN` citations outside released CHANGELOG text, the highest `:5872`. None falls in the moved range `:9084`–`:9527` or on the four import hunks.
    - **The door tests** (`public-form-*.test.ts` and the rest) drive `RestServer` at runtime and read no source by path.
    - **Scripts that pin `rest-server.ts` by path** name no moved token: `check-single-authz-resolver`'s `DELEGATORS`, `check-system-context-census`'s `enforceAuth` row and `check-undeclared-dep-imports`' `objectql` row.
    - **ADR-0138** `:155` and `:509` cite `rest-server.ts#RestServer.registerFormEndpoints`, which still resolves (③ item 6).
    - **The `view.json` notes** (`:337`, `:357`, `:393`) still name `rest-server.ts` in prose and in line ranges, two of which the notes already call superseded. Ruling A kept the notes unchanged, so this slice does not touch them.

### ② Semver level

- **`'@objectstack/spec': patch` is right.**
  - `@objectstack/spec`'s `files` includes `liveness`, so `view.json` ships, and this diff changes its bytes. So a changeset is owed, and `skip-changeset` would be wrong. That label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package.
  - Only evidence strings change. No status moves, so no state count, author warning or lint verdict moves. No schema, export or key moves. `patch` is both the floor and the ceiling.
  - The precedents are the liveness-only changesets in `73c7dc4a3` (an evidence re-point) and `3fed1eb00`, each a `@objectstack/spec` patch.
  - Every factual sentence of the changeset holds against the diff: three rows; three path references for `form.sections` and `form.sharing`; `formViews` now cites the rule where it is declared; quotes, verdicts and notes unchanged.
- **No changeset for `@objectstack/rest` is right.**
  - The `.d.ts` and the export list hold by construction (① item 4), and the routes and their order hold by the move (① item 1).
  - The bundle's code is reorganised with no behaviour change, so there is nothing for a changelog to say. Slices 1–10 landed on the same reading.
  - The one runtime difference is the handler's `this`, now the host literal. Every member it reaches forwards to the server.
- **`Clause-②: no` is right on both carriers:** PR body line 2 and the changeset.
  - The changeset's parenthetical is reasoning, not an arm, so it reads `no` with no arm.
  - The doors read `req.params.slug` (and `req.params.environmentId` on the scoped mount) and the body exactly as before. No accept set widens or narrows, so no `(narrowing)` arm is owed.
- **`Check Changeset`** concluded success on both of its runs, and the PR carries no `skip-changeset` label.

### ③ Boundary flags
